name: MacWhisper
tagline: Private, on-device audio and video transcription for Mac.
description: MacWhisper transcribes audio and video files entirely on your Mac — no internet connection and no data leaving the machine. Drop in MP3, WAV, MOV, or MP4 and get a transcript with speaker labels, timestamps, and 50+ export formats. It runs OpenAI's open-source Whisper (and Nvidia's Parakeet) locally, hitting roughly 30x realtime on Apple Silicon via Metal acceleration.
insight: Built by solo indie developer Jordi Bruin (Good Snooze); sold largely as a one-time lifetime license rather than a subscription.

modelSupport.notes: Runs Whisper and Parakeet models locally on-device.

edge: Fully on-device transcription (Whisper + Parakeet) — no upload, no subscription required, ~30x realtime on Apple Silicon.
cons: Pro features and larger models are gated
Accuracy depends on chosen Whisper model
